title: One More Twirl
premise: A little kid twirls spaghetti and the fork won't stop. The tablecloth, the candle, the breadsticks and the waiter all wind onto it.
visual: Checkered-tablecloth Italian restaurant. A small kid in a bib holds up a fork with a giant spinning ball of spaghetti, tablecloth, breadsticks and a mustached waiter wrapped inside, only his legs and his tray sticking out. The parents' jaws are literally on the table.
characterLean: Use after anyone in the show says 'just a little more.' No Lillith/Rubella needed.
